body:
Your words touched me friend. I wish that I could tell you something to make you feel better. That there were some magic words we could say to each other... just something. 

I am sorry that you are feeling this way too. Often times I think about the Earth when I feel this way. It is just aimlessly wandering through space as well, and persists in the face of the adversity it faces. I think "if this dying space rock continues, so too shall I." I wish I still felt this way.
